name: Spatial BI
description: Spatial business intelligence for any vector layer: KPI summaries, trends, thematic maps, point-to-zone aggregation, Huff market shares and trade areas, new-outlet site selection and Getis-Ord Gi* hot spots. Road distances are optional and come from an OSRM server you provide.
author: Ego Ibnu Wijaksena, Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
